items.name: foundation
items.title: moduix Svelte Tailwind core
items.description: Shared runtime dependencies and foundation styles for moduix Tailwind components.
items.docs: Import '@/lib/moduix/styles/style.css' once before Tailwind in your application stylesheet. Tailwind Preflight provides the reset layer.

items.name: cn
items.title: moduix class name utility
items.description: Merges conditional and conflicting Tailwind class names.

items.name: theme-contrast
items.title: Contrast theme
items.description: High-clarity moduix tokens with stronger borders and focus states for technical interfaces.
items.docs: Import '@/lib/moduix/styles/style.css' once, then import '@/lib/moduix/presets/contrast.css'. Put data-moduix-theme="contrast" on the document root.

items.name: theme-dense
items.title: Dense theme
items.description: Compact moduix tokens with a structured blue palette for admin and data-heavy interfaces.
items.docs: Import '@/lib/moduix/styles/style.css' once, then import '@/lib/moduix/presets/dense.css'. Put data-moduix-theme="dense" on the document root.

items.name: theme-soft
items.title: Soft theme
items.description: Rounded moduix tokens with a warmer violet palette for product workflows.
items.docs: Import '@/lib/moduix/styles/style.css' once, then import '@/lib/moduix/presets/soft.css'. Put data-moduix-theme="soft" on the document root.

items.name: icons
items.title: moduix icons
items.description: Internal icons used by moduix Svelte Tailwind components.

items.name: a11y-labels
items.title: moduix a11y labels
items.description: Internal accessible label defaults required only by registry components that render text fallbacks.

items.name: overlay-portal
items.title: moduix overlay portal
items.description: Internal overlay portal helper required only by overlay registry components.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Composable empty-state surface for no-results, no-data, and first-run screens.

items.name: native-select
items.title: Native Select
items.description: moduix Svelte Tailwind Native Select component.
